finding.root_cause: Extension and Leaf matching in verify() compares nibbles one by one but never validates the remaining nibble count: Leaf matching succeeds when the input key ends even with node nibbles left over, Extension matching stops at the first mismatch and its little-endian padding zeros are indistinguishable from real zeros.
finding.summary: CairoLib's MPT verifier (verify(key, key_len, proof)) matches Extension and Leaf node nibbles without checking how many nibbles remain, so a truncated key or a forged key that skips an Extension node can be verified against someone else's proof (CS-HRDTCL-005, Critical).
finding.title: CairoLib MPT verify accepts partial and forged keys because nibble length is never validated

root_cause.note: the report's example: big-endian bytes [0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaabb, 0x653800] are represented in Words64 as [0xbbaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, 0x3865], and because bytes_used_u64 operates on the value there is no way to know how many leading zeros to include; omitting those trailing zeros of the input yields a different hash
root_cause.value: keccak_cairo_words64 mishandles trailing zeros of the big-endian input because bytes_used_u64 derives the byte length of the last little-endian Words64 item from its value, making leading zero bytes of that item indistinguishable from unused space

finding.root_cause: bytes_used_u64 computes how many bytes of the last Words64 item are significant from the value itself, which cannot distinguish leading zero bytes from unused padding, so trailing zeros of the big-endian input are omitted and the digest differs from keccak of the intended input.
finding.summary: keccak_cairo_words64 hashes big-endian input whose byte string ends in zero bytes incorrectly, because the used length of the last little-endian word is derived from its value and the leading zero bytes of that word are lost (CS-HRDTCL-001, High).
finding.title: CairoLib keccak_cairo_words64 drops leading zero bytes of the last little-endian word

patch.note: report marks the finding Code Corrected as of the Version 4 repository snapshot; no fix commit is published
